name: Default Fund Report 1
definition: Provides details on the calculation of the default fund and the collateral that has been posted by the clearing member.

DefaultFundCalculation.name: Default Fund Calculation
DefaultFundCalculation.definition: Provides details about the calculation of the clearing member contribution to the default fund.

CollateralDescription.name: Collateral Description
CollateralDescription.definition: Provides details about the collateral held.

NetExcessOrDeficit.name: Net Excess Or Deficit
NetExcessOrDeficit.definition: Excess amount that the central counterparty will restitute to the clearing member or deficit to be provided by the member for the guarantee fund.
